unique_links = all_links.unique()

    if cnt==10: break
    print(k,v)

Visualisasi¶

In [22]:
Copied! 
# Ukuran graph tergantung jumlah node
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))

# Layout (posisi node)
pos = nx.spring_layout(G, seed=42)  # bisa juga pakai kamada_kawai_layout

# Gambar graph
nx.draw(
    G,
    pos,
    with_labels=True,
    node_size=300,
    font_size=8,
    node_color="lightblue",
    edge_color="gray"
)

plt.title("Visualisasi Graph dari edges.tsv")
plt.show()
# Ukuran graph tergantung jumlah node plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8)) # Layout (posisi node) pos = nx.spring_layout(G, seed=42) # bisa juga pakai kamada_kawai_layout # Gambar graph nx.draw( G, pos, with_labels=True, node_size=300, font_size=8, node_color="lightblue", edge_color="gray" ) plt.title("Visualisasi Graph dari edges.tsv") plt.show()

Pagerank¶

In [27]:
Copied! 
pr = nx.pagerank(G, alpha=0.85)

top_5 = sorted(pr.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:5]

# Cetak hasil
rank=0
for node, value in top_5:
    rank+=1
    print(f"#{rank} Node {node}: {value:.6f}")
pr = nx.pagerank(G, alpha=0.85) top_5 = sorted(pr.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:5] # Cetak hasil rank=0 for node, value in top_5: rank+=1 print(f"#{rank} Node {node}: {value:.6f}")
